versions.content: If transmit buffering is enabled (see [SWS_CANIF_00063]) and if the call of Can_Write() for a PDU configured for direct transmission returns with CAN_BUSY , CanIf shall check if it is possible to buffer the CanIf Tx L-PDU , which was requested to be transmitted via Can_Write() in a CanIfTxBuffer .
